evidence.note: All commands passed; required changelog review fails chronology.

findings.evidence: CHANGELOG.md:11 says distinct timeout causes and termination results are retained before recovery. cli/fossilize_replay_linux.hpp:443-445 writes native_observed/native_status in process_shutdown after waitpid has established terminal status; cli/fossilize_replay_windows.hpp:363-366 likewise records observed native exit code during shutdown. A signal delivery result may also return after recovery has begun. The wording therefore assigns an unsupported chronology to termination results. The full issue link, Observability tag and practical benefit are otherwise appropriate.
findings.requested_change: Revise the one short sentence so before recovery qualifies recording timeout causes, while termination results are retained separately. Suggested wording: Recorded distinct replay timeout causes before recovery and retained termination results so interrupted work can be diagnosed without mistaking signals for causes.
findings.title: Correct timeout changelog chronology

limitations: Native Windows execution explicitly user-waived and unverified. Windows source paths and portable registration reviewed; Linux evidence does not establish native Windows process/IPC behavior. No new Windows heartbeat watchdog.
All execution is Linux CPU/null-device GNU13.3.0; runtime hardware layer testing disabled by design. No GPU, real driver compilation, Steam, cache warming or durability evidence.

Private test adapters control clocks, Vulkan dispatch and syscall events; actual fork, threads, pipes, epoll, signal handlers, controller recovery and kernel reaping remain exercised. Native child timers are deliberately held beyond fixture watchdog to remove time-based ordering races.
No native big-endian execution or general prebuilt C++ binary ABI verification is claimed. Arithmetic event token invariants and source compatibility have narrower evidence.

Work timeout is documented actual monotonic no-progress elapsed; no separately established policy subtracts intentional whole-process SIGSTOP duration. Existing heartbeat stopped/resumed behavior is asserted. This unspecified work-pause policy is not treated as a new acceptance requirement.
